items.source: Mainly for internal use within the framework; for a more comprehensive suite of assertion utilities consider org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate from Apache Commons Lang, Google Guava's Preconditions, or similar third-party libraries.
items.translation: 主要用于框架内部；如需更全面的断言工具集，请考虑来自 Apache Commons Lang 的 org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate、Google Guava 的 Preconditions，或类似的第三方库。

items.source: For example, if the contract of a public method states it does not allow null arguments, Assert can be used to validate that contract. Doing this clearly indicates a contract violation when it occurs and protects the class's invariants.
items.translation: 例如，如果公共方法的契约规定不允许 `null` 参数，则可以使用 `Assert` 来验证该契约。这样做可以清楚地表明在发生时的契约违反情况，并保护类的不变性。

items.source: Useful for identifying programmer errors early and clearly at runtime.
items.translation: 有助于在运行时早期且清晰地识别程序员错误。

items.source:
Typically used to validate method arguments rather than configuration
properties, to check for cases that are usually programmer errors rather
than configuration errors. In contrast to configuration initialization
code, there is usually no point in falling back to defaults in such methods.
items.translation: 通常用于验证方法参数而非配置属性，以检查通常是程序员错误而非配置错误的情况。与配置初始化代码不同，在此类方法中回退到默认值通常没有意义。

items.source:
Assert a boolean expression, throwing an IllegalArgumentException if the expression evaluates to false. 
Assert.isTrue(i > 0, "The value must be greater than zero");
items.translation:
断言一个布尔表达式，如果该表达式求值为 `false`，则抛出 `IllegalArgumentException`。 
Assert.isTrue(i > 0, "The value must be greater than zero");

items.source:
Assert a boolean expression, throwing an IllegalArgumentException if the expression evaluates to false. 
Assert.isTrue(i > 0, () -> "The value '" + i + "' must be greater than zero");

Assert that superType.isAssignableFrom(subType) is true. 
Assert.isAssignable(Number.class, myClass, "Number expected");
items.translation:
断言 `superType.isAssignableFrom(subType)` 为 `true。 
Assert.isAssignable(Number.class, myClass, "Number expected");

items.source:
Assert that an object is null. 
Assert.isNull(value, "The value must be null");
items.translation:
断言对象为 `null`。 
Assert.isNull(value, "The value must be null");

items.source:
Assert that an object is not null. 
Assert.notNull(clazz, "The class must not be null");
items.translation:
断言对象不为 `null`。 
Assert.notNull(clazz, "类不能为 null");

items.source:
Assert that an object is not null. 
Assert.notNull(entity.getId(),
    () -> "ID for entity " + entity.getName() + " must not be null");
items.translation:
断言对象不为 `null`。 
Assert.notNull(entity.getId(),
    () -> "实体" + entity.getName() + "的 ID 不能为 null");

items.source:
Assert that the given String is not empty; that is, it must not be null and not the empty String. 
Assert.hasLength(name, "Name must not be empty");
items.translation:
断言给定的字符串不为空；即，它不能为 `null` 且不能为空字符串。 
Assert.hasLength(name, "Name must not be empty");

items.source:
Assert that the given String is not empty; that is, it must not be null and not the empty String. 
Assert.hasLength(account.getName(),
    () -> "Name for account '" + account.getId() + "' must not be empty");
items.translation:
断言给定的字符串不为空；即，它不能为 null 且不能为空字符串。 
Assert.hasLength(account.getName(),
    () -> "账户 '" + account.getId() + "' 的名称不能为空");

items.source:
Assert that the given String contains valid text content; that is, it must not be null and must contain at least one non-whitespace character. 
Assert.hasText(name, "'name' must not be empty");
items.translation:
断言给定的 String 包含有效的文本内容；即，它不能为 `null` 且必须至少包含一个非空白字符。 
Assert.hasText(name, "'name' 不能为空");

items.source:
Assert that the given String contains valid text content; that is, it must not be null and must contain at least one non-whitespace character. 
Assert.hasText(account.getName(),
    () -> "Name for account '" + account.getId() + "' must not be empty");
items.translation:
断言给定的 String 包含有效的文本内容；也就是说，它不能为 null，且必须至少包含一个非空白字符。

    () -> "账户 '" + account.getId() + "' 的名称不能为空");

items.source:
Assert that an array contains elements; that is, it must not be null and must contain at least one element. 
Assert.notEmpty(array, "The array must contain elements");
items.translation:
断言数组包含元素；即，它不能为`null`且必须至少包含一个元素。 
Assert.notEmpty(array, "The array must contain elements");

items.source:
Assert that an array contains elements; that is, it must not be null and must contain at least one element. 
Assert.notEmpty(array, () -> "The " + arrayType + " array must contain elements");

Assert that a collection contains elements; that is, it must not be null and must contain at least one element. 
Assert.notEmpty(collection, "Collection must contain elements");

断言集合包含元素；即，它不能为`null`且必须至少包含一个元素。

items.source:

Assert that a Map contains entries; that is, it must not be null and must contain at least one entry.

断言 Map 包含条目；即，它不能为 `null` 且必须至少包含一个条目。 
Assert.notEmpty(map, "Map 必须包含条目");

items.source:

Assert that the given String is not empty; that is, it must not be null and not the empty String.
items.translation: 断言给定的 String 不为空；也就是说，它不能是null且不能为空 String。

items.source:

items.source: message - a message which will be prepended to provide further context. If it is empty or ends in ":" or ";" or "," or ".", a full exception message will be appended. If it ends in a space, the name of the offending object's type will be appended. In any other case, a ":" with a space and the name of the offending object's type will be appended.
items.translation: message - 一个将被附加以提供更多上下文的消息。如果它为空或以":"、";"、","或"."结尾，将附加完整的异常消息。如果它以空格结尾，将附加违规对象类型的名称。在任何其他情况下，将附加一个带空格的":"以及违规对象类型的名称。

items.source: message - a message which will be prepended to provide further context. If it is empty or ends in ":" or ";" or "," or ".", a full exception message will be appended. If it ends in a space, the name of the offending subtype will be appended. In any other case, a ":" with a space and the name of the offending subtype will be appended.
items.translation: message - 一条将附加到前面以提供更多上下文的消息。如果该消息为空或以":"、";"、","或"."结尾，则附加完整的异常消息。如果它以空格结尾，则附加违规子类型的名称。在任何其他情况下，将附加一个带空格的":"以及违规子类型的名称。
